audited_source_corrections.action: Corrected the chapter header comment from three-valued-logics to sequent-calculus.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The driver has olchapter id mvl/seq and imports only sequent-calculus sections, but its copied source header names three-valued-logics.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் கோப்பு மேல்தகவலை அதன் seq அதிகார அடையாளத்துக்கும் நான்கு தொடரணிக் கணிய இறக்குமதிகளுக்கும் ஒத்திசைக்கிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Retaining the copied three-valued header; changing the stable seq chapter id.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The stable id, title, file path, and every import identify the sequent-calculus chapter.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the corrected header agree with mvl/seq and the four imported sections?

audited_source_corrections.action: Changed the final antecedent index in the displayed sequent from n to m.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The sequent display lists A_1 through A_n, but its immediately following interpretation conjoins A_1 through A_m while the succedent independently lists B_1 through B_n.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் முன்தொடரின் இறுதி உறுப்பை $A_m$ என்றும் பின்தொடரின் இறுதி உறுப்பை $B_n$ என்றும் வேறுபடுத்துகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Changing the interpreted conjunction to A_n; forcing both sides to have equal lengths.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: Standard sequent notation permits independently sized antecedent and succedent sequences, and the following formula explicitly fixes their lengths as m and n.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the repaired display now match the A_1-through-A_m conjunction and independent B_1-through-B_n disjunction?

audited_source_corrections.action: Restored v as the valuation argument of pValue in the false-value alternative.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The true alternative evaluates A under v, while the false alternative drops the valuation argument even though the sentence is proving every classical valuation satisfies A-sequent-A.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் மெய், பொய் ஆகிய இரு மாற்றுகளிலும் ஒரே மதிப்பீடு $v$ ஐ வெளிப்படையாகக் குறிப்பிடுகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Leaving the false value unindexed; deleting v from the true alternative too.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: Both alternatives concern the value assigned to the same formula by the same arbitrary valuation.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Are both exhaustive classical truth-value alternatives now explicitly evaluated under v?

audited_source_corrections.action: Corrected the part header comment from first-order-logic to many-valued-logic.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The file lies under many-valued-logic and has olfileid mvl/seq/rul, but its copied source header names first-order-logic.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் மேல்தகவல் mvl/seq/rul என்ற நிலையான அடையாளத்திற்குரிய பல்மதிப்புத் தருக்கப் பகுதியைப் பெயரிடுகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Retaining the copied first-order header; changing the stable mvl file id.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The whole section defines n-sided calculi for finite-valued matrices, not first-order quantifier rules.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the corrected part header agree with the mvl file id and n-valued content?

audited_source_corrections.action: Changed each Gamma_1 to each Gamma_i and made sequence singular.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: After displaying Gamma_1 through Gamma_n, the source says each Gamma_1 is finite sequences, repeating the first component and using plural agreement.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் ஒவ்வொரு $\Gamma_i$ உம் ஒரு முடிவுறு தொடராகும் என்று வரையறுக்கிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Constraining only Gamma_1; treating each component as several sequences.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: An n-sided sequent has one finite sequence in every indexed position, as the display and subsequent position-wise definitions require.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the repaired clause quantify over every indexed component and assign one sequence to each?

audited_source_corrections.action: Made explicit that every position other than the constant's truth-value position is empty.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The source says the constant appears in its associated truth-value space 'and is empty otherwise,' leaving the grammatical subject of 'is empty' unclear.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் மாறிலி அதற்குரிய இடத்தில் தோன்றும் என்றும் மற்ற எல்லா இடங்களும் வெறுமையாக இருக்கும் என்றும் கூறுகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Saying the constant itself is empty; leaving unspecified which components are empty.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The displayed ellipses and position semantics require a singleton constant in exactly one component and empty sequences elsewhere.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the clarified clause uniquely determine the nullary connective's initial n-sided sequent?

audited_source_corrections.action: Normalized the part header comment from many-valued-logics to the repository's many-valued-logic part name.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The file path and all neighboring files use the singular directory name many-valued-logic, while this copied header alone uses many-valued-logics.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் மேல்தகவல் களஞ்சியப் பாதையின் நிலையான many-valued-logic பெயரைப் பயன்படுத்துகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Retaining the isolated plural header; renaming the repository part and stable paths.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: This is a metadata normalization that leaves all executable identifiers and mathematical content unchanged.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the normalized header now match the actual part path?

audited_source_corrections.action: Corrected the part header comment from first-order-logic to many-valued-logic.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The file has olfileid mvl/seq/prl and gives three-valued propositional rules, but its copied source header names first-order-logic.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் மேல்தகவல் mvl/seq/prl மற்றும் முழுப் பிரிவின் பல்மதிப்புக் கூற்று விதிகளுடன் ஒத்த many-valued-logic பகுதியைப் பெயரிடுகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Retaining the copied first-order header; changing the stable mvl id.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: No quantifier or first-order rule occurs; every rule is determined by a finite truth-function matrix.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the corrected header agree with the mvl id and the displayed propositional rules?
